p: When Sylvie killed He Who Remains in Loki, the single locked timeline broke into countless branches. Loki now holds them together, but the multiverse is open and still growing.
Multiverse of Madness showed what happens when realities get too close: an incursion, where two universes collide and both are destroyed. Clea warned Strange he'd already caused one.
Deadpool crossed from Earth-10005 into the TVA. Doom showed up on Earth-828 next to Franklin. And Thunderbolts* ended with a Fantastic Four ship arriving at our Earth from another dimension.
Marvel's own description of Doomsday is heroes from three separate universes on a collision course against Doom. How exactly the worlds come together is the part Marvel is keeping secret.
